tickets.title: Define the axiom JSON schema and validator
tickets.description: Slot, tags, conflicts, and the directive blocks (terrain, settlement, biomes, poi, enemies, traversal, economy, palette, audio). Enforce the rule that every axiom touches at least four blocks.

tickets.title: Implement slot rolling for A-E from the world seed
tickets.description: Five independent slots, Anomaly rolled on ~33% of seeds. Deterministic from worldSeed. Doc 01, slot architecture.

tickets.title: Implement directive merging with slot priority
tickets.description: Merge directive blocks with conflicts resolved by slot priority A > B > C > D > E into a single WorldConfig.

tickets.title: Implement the conflicts blocklist
tickets.description: Hard blocklist preventing incoherent pairs (e.g. Drowning + Long Winter). Blocking is cheaper than reconciling.

tickets.title: Author Cataclysm axioms: Gods Died, Drowning, Silence
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot A. Each needs full directive blocks plus supporting content references.

tickets.title: Author Law axioms: Blood-price, Ore-bound, Dying
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot B. Highest mechanical reach of any slot — these drive combat, economy, progression and HUD.

tickets.title: Author Powers axioms: Merchant compacts, Occupation, Decaying empire
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot C. Drives faction ecology, settlement density and road quality.

tickets.title: Author Pressure axioms: Blight, Wakening, Rival
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot D. The campaign clock. Hidden at creation, discovered in play.

tickets.title: Author Anomaly axioms: three from the list
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot E. High-variance identity, rolled ~33% of seeds.

tickets.title: Handle the Petty kingdoms 'no single Incumbent' special case
tickets.description: Three or four holds each running the Incumbent script at reduced scale. Doc 03.

tickets.title: Handle the 'No one' post-state faction ecology
tickets.description: No Incumbent at all; Parasites and Refuseniks expand into the vacuum. Genuinely different ecology. Doc 03.

tickets.title: World title and summary composition
tickets.description: Generate the new-game screen block (e.g. 'The Age of Salt — the sea took the lowlands...'). This is save identity, marketing, and the thing players screenshot.

tickets.title: New-game screen: show slots A-C, hide D and E
tickets.description: Players choose their fantasy from Cataclysm, Law and Powers; Pressure and Anomaly are discovered in play.

tickets.title: Shared data/ loading in both generator and game
tickets.description: Axiom JSON read by libworldforge and imported to UE DataAssets at build time. Single source of truth. Doc 17.
